# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probe targets BERT4Rec through a family-specific `ModelView`; `view.model` is the trained network. Relevant hooks are `item_emb`, `log2feats`, `predict_score`, `encode_sequence` and `score_candidates`. Inference left-pads the retained history, appends a reserved mask (`itemnum + 1`), and reads `encode_sequence(tokens)[:, -1]`. Candidate scores are dot products with item embeddings. The backbone implementation is not supplied here.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` receives the network, public training histories and metadata interfaces. `run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` temporarily enables evaluation/inference mode and restores module modes and Python, NumPy and Torch RNG states afterward.

Consumed records are sought on the loader, view, then network. At most four records are replayed; the production iterator is never advanced. Margin batches use `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with matching B × L tensors, selecting the first captured negative.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Integrity:** Checks reserved-mask IDs, observed inference tokens, final-position scoring, finite scores, live inference agreement and padding invariance. Explicit failures flag structural problems; unavailable checks remain unknown.
- **Consumed-pipeline audit:** Reconstructs crops, event identities, masking, labels and seeded negatives from histories. Captured same-forward logits optionally verify CE/BPR loss reduction, without another forward or gradient certification.
- **Embedding collapse:** Maps mean off-diagonal catalog-embedding cosine to `[0,1]`. Higher values indicate stronger angular alignment; this alone does not establish recommendation quality.
- **Training margins:** Reports mean, tenth percentile, negative-outranks-positive rate and margin-below-0.5 rate at valid masked targets. Larger margins and lower failure rates indicate stronger training-target separation.

# Perturbation & Tests

Synthetic controls test shifted provenance, omitted masks, incorrect `count-1` readout, padding changes and right-context influence. Replay calibration injects verified label/mask faults and checks clean and row-permuted controls.

History sensitivity removes or masks oldest/newest blocks for up to 200 users. Frozen candidate sets across interventions yield target scores, ranks, HR@10, margins, deltas and top-10 overlap, with separate candidate draws, strata and user-bootstrap intervals. Required structural failures skip this probe.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

Output contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, covering integrity, replay, collapse, margins and history sensitivity, including counts and unavailable reasons. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` requests an evidence-grounded JSON interpretation.

Training recovery does not measure held-out generalization. Interventions are not causal preference tests. Fresh-process checkpoint/predictor parity, complete gradient wiring, attention deletion and four-category macro validation remain uncertified; unavailable metadata is not inferred.
